name: BRIEFME
description: BRIEFME is a legal NLP benchmark focused on assisting with legal briefs through three tasks: argument summarization, argument completion, and case retrieval. It evaluates language models' ability to understand legal texts and generate persuasive legal arguments, highlighting strengths and weaknesses of current LLMs in legal NLP.
reputation: A newly introduced legal NLP benchmark that is useful for probing legal reasoning and retrieval, but it has not yet seen broad community adoption.
notes: Focuses on legal brief writing and editing; current LLMs perform well on summarization but poorly on argument completion and case retrieval.
